change_intent: Tighten Customer.email from optional to required.
rationale: Customer 360 wants every record to carry a contact email so the lifecycle team can deliver onboarding and policy-mandated notifications. Currently 5 of 20 seeded rows (the 'import' source) have NULL emails — the data-conformance axis will surface them.

semantic_contract.meaning_before: Customer.email is an optional contact handle; legacy import rows may have NULL.
semantic_contract.meaning_after: Every Customer is guaranteed to carry a non-null contact email.
semantic_contract.justification: Refines the meaning of Customer by strengthening an invariant. Same shape as the Account.email case — proves the data-conformance axis works on the second domain without per-domain wiring.
invariants: Every Customer row has a non-null email.
No new Customer can be created without an email.

tests.name: no_null_email_post_migration
tests.assertion: After migration, no Customer row has email = NULL.

provenance.author: user://customer-platform-team
provenance.source_prompt: Tighten Customer.email to required for the Customer 360 domain.
